decision: Selected the Ryhti reference point of permanent building 104272864S, the middle one of the three two-storey data-centre buildings (15,615 m2) under Seinäjoki permit 3024006057 on property 743-16-4-2 (Flinkinsuora 3, Kivenneva), as the project locator for SJK01 Phase 1. It locates that building's register point; it is not a footprint, the 22.3 ha plot, the roughly 150 ha campus or a works extent.

selected_properties.main_purpose: code 02 (office, production, utility and other buildings)

identity_bridge: City of Seinäjoki news of 10 April 2026: the city sold the 22.3 ha plot of the Kivenneva data-centre area on Itäväylä, east of the Eskoo interchange along Seinäjoentie, to Pure DC (FIN01) PROJECTS Oy; the sale allows three data centres and their support buildings on that plot under an already legally valid building permit. The council approved the plan change that formed the 22.4 ha plot in December 2025.

Kivenneva detailed-plan change 16003 (blocks 1, 3 and 4; council 15 December 2025): blocks 4 to 7 are merged into block 4 (T-11, data-centre use allowed, with reserve power plants and substations); the first phase of the data centre is built between Seinäjoentie and Ämmäläntie; the plan description shows Pure DC visualisations of the first construction phase.

Ryhti: property 743-16-4-2 (municipality 743 Seinäjoki, district 16 Kivenneva, block 4, plot 2) carries permit 3024006057, decided 17 February 2026 (before the April sale), for exactly three large two-storey buildings of 15,040 to 15,615 m2 plus 18 small ancillary buildings (three recorded as lapsed), 21 records in all, at Flinkinsuora 3; construction started on 29 April 2026. Flinkinsuora is the street retained in plan 16003.
Pure DC's Seinäjoki pages say the SJK01 campus is being built in the new Kivenneva industrial area and that Phase 1 (110 MW IT) is under construction.
